about: The world's ground as one height grid (documentation/terrain-height-grid-plan-2026-10-12.md). Stage 1 spec, 2026-10-12. Extended for Stage 4, 2026-10-14: the inner tiles grew into the sea and an outer tier was added.
axes: Godot: x east, y up, z south. An image is a map, north up: row r is z = tile_z0 + spacing * r, column c is x = tile_x0 + spacing * c.
tile_edges: shared: a tile's last row and column repeat its neighbour's first, bit for bit
tile_origin: tile (tx, tz) starts at x = 1000 * tx, z = 1000 * tz
missing_tiles: A tile with no file holds no ground. Since Stage 4 (2026-10-14) the 38 sea tiles outside x -2..3, z -3..7 have no baseline/ file, ever, and no height/ or colour/ file until the seabed is written; the generator reads zero change there.

outer.about: Stage 4 (2026-10-14): the sea floor beyond the inner tiles, every 8 m (the plan's review notes: 2 m within about 1 km of land, 8 m beyond). Tile (ox, oz) starts at x = 4000 * ox, z = 4000 * oz, 501 nodes a side sharing edges like the inner tiles: node (c, r) at x = 4000 * ox + 8 * c, z = 4000 * oz + 8 * r, north up.

files.height: outer/height/x{ox}_z{oz}.exr, one float32 channel Y, Godot y in metres, NaN for none
files.colour: outer/colour/x{ox}_z{oz}.png, 8-bit sRGB RGBA, alpha 0 where there is none

outer.inner_domain: Nodes inside the inner tiles' domain (x -3000..5000, z -4000..9000), its edge included, are no-data here: the inner tiles own them. The domain's edge falls on 8 m nodes, and the build takes those nodes' heights from the inner tiles.
outer.no_baseline: The outer tier has no baseline/: the generator never reads it.

files.height: height/x{tx}_z{tz}.exr, one float32 channel, Godot y in metres, NaN where there is no ground of the master's
files.baseline: baseline/x{tx}_z{tz}.exr, the same from the frozen copy the generator measures change from
files.colour: colour/x{tx}_z{tz}.png, 8-bit sRGB RGBA, the land's colour at each node, alpha 0 where there is no ground

holes: holes.json: the outlines where generator-held ground (road corridor, tunnel lids, west shell, the anchors) meets the master's, from their open edges, exact

tolerance_zones.about: Vertical tolerance of the ground's tile meshes (tools/blender/ground_build.py) against the grid's bilinear surface, at every node, edge midpoint and cell centre a triangle covers; at a centre, or the cell's own |z00 + z11 - z10 - z01| / 4 where that is larger, which even the full grid mesh is off by. A point takes the smallest tolerance of the zones that hold it; plan metres, Godot x and z. Written by `ground_build.py --write-zones`.

zones.name: park
zones.source: ParkPlan.REBUILD_FOOTPRINT_MIN_X, _MAX_X, _MIN_Z, _MAX_Z (the developed park's envelope, -212..222, -230..220) plus 45 m

zones.name: walkable
zones.source: Within within_m of any road centreline in lines, or inside polygons. ParkPlan: highway_path(), approach_road_points(), the front road (FRONT_ROAD_Z, _HALF_X), town_streets(); north_town_outline(), BEACH_TOWN_OUTLINE. assets/source/far_shore_city_relocation.blend: the road ribbons' centres (city_highway_extension, bridge_main_deck, bridge_city_southern_offramp, southern_city_bypass_centreline, southern_coastal_highway_extension_centreline; bridge_city_intersection's outline) and the city, the plan hull of city_block_*, city_skyline_anchor_* and city_ferry_terminal.

deep_sea.about: Stage 4 (2026-10-14): the sea the inner tiles grew into, outside outside_rect (the inner tiles as Stage 1 baked them, x -2000..4000, z -3000..8000), takes tolerance_m wherever the ground is below below_m, instead of its zone's.
